card.name: Inside drug and chemical names
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of drug or chemical names, such as tr in yttrium, om in idomide, av in ... onavir, and pt in ...riptine. It fires on the piece after the opening letters, before the name ends.

modes.label: Antiviral and antifungal names
modes.description: The av piece inside names ending in -navir, such as ritonavir or paritaprevir combinations.

modes.label: Other drug and element names
modes.description: Middle pieces of names like pomalidomide, bromocriptine, enalapril, and yttrium.

card.plain: It lights up partway through a long drug or chemical name, before the name is finished.
